title: Sphere
author: Michael Crichton
summary: A psychologist and a small team of experts are called to a deep-sea habitat in the Pacific, where a huge object has been found on the ocean floor. Strange things begin to happen once they go inside it.
readIf: you like science thrillers set in a sealed location with a big, creepy unknown at the centre.
skipIf: you want a neat explanation; the ending is more atmospheric than satisfying for some readers.

pairings.reason: Another Crichton thriller that tracks a team of scientists confronted with something alien.
A creepier, more literary expedition into an unexplainable zone where the rules no longer apply.
A philosophical classic about humans meeting an intelligence they cannot understand.
